newsitem.title: CHINA: China issues rules on business of related firms.
newsitem.headline: China issues rules on business of related firms.

text.p: China has issued new rules ordering companies to fully disclose information on related firms, the Shanghai Securities News said on Thursday.
Under the rules, which take effect immediately, companies must report all details of related firms including the value of all settled and outstanding transactions, the newspaper said.
Related firms include any joint ventures a company has, and any firms in which they have a controlling stake or vice versa, it said.
The rules, issued by the Finance Ministry, apply only to listed companies for the time being, it said.
